mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We are seeing 65 degrees with fog at Verona City Hall. Tonight, the temperature will drop to an overnight low of 60 degrees with rain in the forecast. If you are looking up at the sky, the space station will be visible tonight at 7:40 PM, rising from the northwest near Verona High School and traveling toward the northeast near the Madison Home Depot.

The city has announced that chip sealing road maintenance begins September 23. This work will affect Cross Country Road and parts of East Verona Avenue, so please expect lane closures and use caution in those areas.

There is plenty to do this weekend, starting with the Sugar River Fire and Smoke BBQ Festival and the Dane County Farmers Market, both happening today. Looking ahead, you can catch Bike the Barns at Badger Prairie County Park tomorrow.
In our weekly report, on September 3, a 33 year old Madison man was arrested for O W I, second offence, after crashing his vehicle on Shooting Star Road.

Culver's is currently closed for a remodel, so they are not serving their flavor of the day today. They are usually open daily until 10:30 PM, but please check back later for updates on when the restaurant will reopen.
